title: Quantity and quality of exercise for developing and maintaining cardiorespiratory, musculoskeletal, and neuromotor fitness in apparently healthy adults: guidance for prescribing exercise

keyFinding.enGB: Apparently healthy adults should accumulate regular aerobic, resistance, flexibility and neuromotor exercise with dose guidance for fitness and health.
keyFinding.uk: Умовно здорові дорослі мають регулярно поєднувати аеробні, силові, гнучкісні та нейромоторні вправи з орієнтирами дози для форми й здоров’я.

evidenceGrade.rationale: ACSM quantity/quality position stand synthesising extensive evidence.
